Name: High-Protein Overnight Oats
Description: Simple macro-friendly breakfast that's ready when you wake up. Perfect for busy mornings.
content:
Ingredients

  • 80g rolled oats
  • 40g vanilla whey protein powder
  • 200ml unsweetened almond milk
  • 1 tablespoon chia seeds
  • 1 tablespoon natural peanut butter
  • Optional: berries, banana, honey for topping

Instructions

  1. Combine oats, protein powder, almond milk, and chia seeds in a mason jar or container
  2. Stir well to ensure protein powder is fully mixed in
  3. Add peanut butter on top (don't mix yet - creates a nice layer)
  4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight
  5. In the morning, stir well and add your favorite toppings
  6. Enjoy cold or microwave for 1-2 minutes if you prefer it warm

Nutrition (approximate)

  • Calories: 520
  • Protein: 45g
  • Carbs: 52g
  • Fat: 14g

Tips

  • Make multiple servings on Sunday for the whole week
  • Experiment with different protein powder flavors
  • Add cinnamon for extra flavor without calories
  • Use Greek yogurt instead of some milk for extra protein and thickness
